# Plasmatic

> Plasmatic builds Orion, a governed services platform for teams building
> software with AI. A JSON definition becomes a live, governed REST or Kafka
> service: the runtime carries the endpoint, validation, retries, rate
> limiting, credentials, metrics, versioning and rollback, so the part a person
> or an AI assistant writes is the business logic and nothing else.

Plasmatic Solutions Pte. Ltd. is registered in Singapore (UEN 202602426M).
Orion is open source under the Apache License 2.0. The commercial relationship
is delivery, support and enterprise engagement, not a licence to the runtime.

## What Orion is

Orion sits under your business logic as a runtime rather than beside it as a
framework. One governed document describes a service; the platform coordinates,
observes and controls how that service behaves in production.

It runs five kinds of service:

- **Microservice APIs** — request-shaped work answered in milliseconds.
- **Decision APIs** — pricing tiers and eligibility as JSONLogic condition
  trees, where the decision is the response.
- **Event pipelines** — a Kafka topic in, transform and enrich, publish onward,
  with retries, duplicate suppression and a dead-letter queue.
- **Webhook and data ingestion** — normalize Stripe, GitHub or Shopify payloads,
  then write to your databases over pooled connections.
- **AI agent tools** — agents call your channels as tools and, through the CLI
  and admin API, draft the workflows behind them, inside a draft / dry-run /
  explicit-activation lifecycle.

## How it governs AI-authored change

Every change moves through the same gate regardless of who wrote it. The AI
proposes a definition, a person approves one document, and the runtime enforces
the lifecycle: draft, then dry-run, then explicit activation. Every decision is
traced and every version is reversible in one call.

## What Orion is not for

Orion is for request-shaped work measured in milliseconds. The documentation
names where each neighbouring tool wins instead — Temporal for durable
execution, Kong for the API edge, Drools for rule evaluation, and general
automation platforms for long-running human workflows.

- [Is Orion right for you?](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/comparison.html)
- [Durable execution](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/compare/durable-execution.html)
